notes.title: 🌟 New Sky Harvest Trailer - Explore Magica Like Never Before!
notes.content:
Hey Magica adventurers! ☁️✨
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341531/28d92ed81206aa68d645437247f05e7d6ccfae86.png"]

We’re so excited to share the brand-new Sky Harvest trailer with you.

Take a fresh look at the floating islands, meet some of the charming characters, and see more of the cozy life you’ll be able to build in the skies. Whether you’re fishing in floating lakes, crafting your dream home, or trading with your skybound neighbors, there’s always something magical to discover.✨🌈



🎥 Watch the new trailer here: 


[previewyoutube="8u10JosmBGU;full"][/previewyoutube]


We’d love to hear what you think! 💌 Leave a comment below and let us know which part of Magica you can’t wait to explore. 🐑🌼

notes.title: 🛑 New Demo v1.0 Live Now 🛑
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341531/331fea93c34ad3f93cdde5c26a5bff3f0da91ec9.png

I am so happy to announce that new demo is NOW LIVE on Steam!
Also, I would love to hear your feedback that you can always share in ⁠our Discord Server.! 

Here's the list of changes I made, that I remember on top of my head right now :

 Tutorials
 New UI
 Improved NPC Dialogs and interactions
 Farm Overhaul
 Increased the overall beauty
 Added Axe, Sickle and Pickaxe for resource gathering
 Fixed a LOT OF BUGS! 🙈
 


Happy Farming! 🧑‍🌾
